notes: Read all 472 numbered source lines before editing. The file is the canonical concept-to-icon registry: it imports ~190 lucide-react glyphs and maps each app concept to one. lucide-react is DOM/SVG-only and is NOT a native dependency, so the per-icon import block could not be ported verbatim; the native app's canonical glyph source of truth (components/icons/SemanticIcon.tsx) already mirrors this registry's concepts key-for-key, so every concept routes through it (conversion contract rules 4-7).

L1-L15 module JSDoc (the RULES block: always import via this file not the icon package; adding an icon makes it canonical; related concepts intentionally collapse to one visual; app primitives stay as assets) preserved in intent beneath a native header documenting the web->native rationale and the full preserved surface.

L17-L215 the 198-line lucide-react import block (Activity..Zap + `type LucideIcon`) has no native analog because lucide-react is absent. Replaced by: createElement + Text/TextStyle from react-native; IconComponentType/IconRenderProps from the native components/ui/Icon (the RN analog of 'any icon component'); getSemanticIconDefinition + SemanticIconName from components/icons/SemanticIcon (canonical glyph source); colors from theme/tokens. Verified every one of the 204 web concept keys exists as a SemanticIconName (exact key-for-key, same order/sections).

L214/L217 `type LucideIcon` import + `export type { LucideIcon }` -> `export type LucideIcon = IconComponentType` (the RN icon contract: numeric size + color + style + RN a11y), re-exported under the same name so ported call sites doing `import { type LucideIcon } from '@/lib/icons'` keep type-checking.

L219-L230 the Icons JSDoc (naming guidance: semantic concept names, short UI/action verbs, lower-camel-case specialty fallbacks, all registry-routed for audit accuracy) ported and adapted to native wording.

L231-L469 the `Icons` registry: all 204 concept entries ported key-for-key in the exact same source order and section grouping (Severity & status, Battery/charging, Vehicle/mobility, Analytics/charts, Notifications/alerts, Climate/weather, Security/access, Media, Maintenance/system, People, Cost, Time/scheduling, UI/actions with its search/edit/refresh/show sub-groups, Vehicle systems/state, Specialty one-offs). Each web `concept: <LucideComponent>` becomes `concept: glyphIcon('concept')`, where glyphIcon builds an IconComponentType that renders that concept's canonical SemanticIcon glyph at the requested numeric size/colour and forwards the RN accessibility props the shared Icon wrapper supplies (the same LinkGlyph/HashGlyph stand-in pattern used by the sibling devtools ports). Web concepts that collapse to one lucide glyph (severityWarn/warning, drive/drives, range/speed -> Gauge, heating/sun -> Sun) still resolve to a valid same-intent native glyph; the `satisfies Record<string, LucideIcon>` constraint is preserved so keyof stays a precise literal union.
L471-L472 `export type IconKey = keyof typeof Icons` ported verbatim; the explicit object literal keeps IconKey as the precise 204-member concept union.

Browser-only behavior: none. lucide-react is a rendering dependency, not browser-API behavior, so a real native-safe port was made (no 'unavailable' state needed) by routing to the existing native glyph registry. The file is a `.ts` like the web source, so React.createElement is used instead of JSX; no lucide-react, no DOM <svg>, no Recharts/Leaflet, and no web UI imports.

Verified under apps/native with `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`. Added __tests__/Icons.test.tsx asserting: Object.keys(Icons) equals the full 204-key web concept list in source order; every entry is a function component tagged displayName `Icon(<concept>)`; rendering a concept emits its canonical getSemanticIconDefinition().glyph with the numeric size (lineHeight) and colour flowing through and the a11y label forwarded; the 16px / round(16*0.6)=10 fontSize default branch; and IconKey assignability.
